# H04P evidence / Протокол H04P

## Reviewed result

**PASS — HW OBSERVED for the bounded H04P scope.** The current shared-path runner
completed all 21 powered CV/CC and fixed `power_only` measurement points across CH1,
CH2 and CH3. Every point passed mode and KEL103 V/I/P comparison thresholds. The full
per-command actual response trace and structured measurements follow below; the raw
event stream is [available separately](../../reports/hardware/2026-10-26T182637.334275Z_H04P/events.jsonl).

Before powering, panel Max Volt Set was 4.50 V on each channel; 4.51 V attempts clamped
to 4.50 V. The guarded API rejected over-cap V/I without sending SCPI. Three explicitly
gated diagnostic `VOLT 4.51` probes returned `120, "Parameter overflowed"`, preserved
the 3.30 V setpoint and left the queue clean afterward. Of 2,836 recorded `SYST:ERR?`
responses, 2,833 were `0, "No error"` and the other three were those expected probes.
Every point verified non-target PSU channels OFF and KEL103 INPUT OFF between readings;
operator-confirmed final physical state was all PSU outputs OFF and KEL103 INPUT OFF.

KEL103 was connected one channel at a time in CR mode: 47 Ω for common/channel/preset
CV values, 56 Ω at the 4.50 V boundary, and 22/11/5 Ω for 0.100/0.250/0.500 A CC.
The tested setpoints were common 3.30 V, channel values CH1=2.20 V / CH2=3.30 V /
CH3=4.40 V, 4.50 V profile boundary, then current points on all three channels and a
fixed `power_only` preset per channel. All measurements were below 1.3 W. CH3's
`STAT:OPER:INST:ISUM3:COND?` was 8 in CV and CC; QUES was 1/2 respectively, consistent
with library mode inference and KEL103 readings. `*IDN?` firmware fields varied between
`1.04-0.01` and `1.04-1.04`; operator menu firmware was Main 1.04 / Aux 0.01. No
calibrated DMM was used; no unrestricted rated output was tested. The run records source
commit `ba3fabfe3afa7d1703b1dfa42b2c8b034dd36bf8` with the matrix-gate regression
assertion change pending, so outcome is HW OBSERVED, not HW VERIFIED.
